title: Verify: Boy manifest animations, sizes and generator unit tests
summary: Unit tests for generated entries and manifest declaration
description: Test generateAssets copies animations, PNG sizes via readPngSize, and ART_SOURCES entries are manifest-valid.
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; no filesystem, generator run in memory

steps.action: Call generateAssets(ART_SOURCES). Find entries character:boy-art and character:boy-portrait. Assert boy-art dimensions {448,48}, frames {32,48,14}, animations idle.frames [0,1,2,3], walk.frames length 6 starting 4, interact.frames [10..13], each with numeric frameRate, origin {0.5,1}; portrait dimensions {32,32}; readPngSize of each file bytes equals dimensions; parseManifest({version:1, assets: entries}) is ok; add a case with a source lacking animations producing an entry with no animations key.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/boyManifest.test.ts
